title: 'If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way' is ignored.
expected: Safety Inspector (riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/safety-inspector.ts) has no hand-written abilities, so enrich-cards.ts:30 parses rulesText. Running parseAbilities on the exact rulesText yields only `{type:"kill", player:"each", target:{type:"unit"}}` on trigger play-self — the "If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way" clause is dropped entirely (matched by riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-damage.ts:140-150, which emits no condition). On the engine side, riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/kill.ts:8-37 (handle_kill) has no branch for `player: "each"` nor any check of triggerEvent.paidAdditionalCost; it just calls getTargetIds on the generic {type:"unit"} target, producing a single mandatory choose-any-unit prompt for the controller (grep confirms no `player === "each"` handling anywhere in the engine outside channel/draw/discard). Hence paying the 3 XP has no effect on resolution, matching the observed behavior.
observed: Played with additionalCostSpec {xp:3} (XP 3->0, paidAdditionalCost:true on the chain item), yet on resolution player-1 still received the same mandatory choose-target kill prompt (options included p1's own Recruit token and Safety Inspector itself) with no way to decline.
